short: The first ocean-going ironclad battleship, launched by the French Navy in 1859.
full:
Designed by the naval architect Henri Dupuy de Lôme, La Gloire was a pioneering wooden-hulled steam frigate clad in thick iron armour plates. Launched in 1859, her creation was spurred by the vulnerability of wooden warships to explosive shells, a weakness starkly demonstrated during the Crimean War.

Her deployment rendered existing unarmoured fleets instantly obsolete, sparking a naval arms race between France and Britain. While she successfully proved the viability of sea-going ironclads, rapid technological advances quickly eclipsed her design. She served for two decades before being struck from the naval register in 1879 and subsequently scrapped.
